title: Portable External Execution Evidence
summary: Optional, read-only import of bounded external test evidence for receipt-check, Resume and Impact without executing actions or upgrading static evidence.

release.generatorCompatibility: Current generator-v17 publication identity; this contract does not add a compatibility reader or migration branch.

workflow.meaning: Capture one external shin.execution-inputs.v1 manifest before the run and persist it outside the consumer and generated index.

The host independently executes the explicitly authorized test or check and the producer emits a complete declaration, sanitized command fingerprint, result metadata and one local report. Shin never starts the action.

commands: receipt-check --input BUNDLE --task-id ID --thread-id ID [--observed-at UNIX] [--trusted-producer ID] [--require-current] [--strict]
workflow.meaning: Import and assess the receipt, then embed the bounded receipt and its next_actions into an external checkpoint or Impact result when those host workflows request it.

inputRequest.selectors: At most 32 distinct non-overlapping canonical repository-relative {path,kind} selectors, where kind is file or tree. Profile coverage has no selectors; declared-complete and partial require at least one. Selectors cannot name root, .git or private host state, escape the root, or traverse symlinks.

inputManifest.binding: Root, profile, profile_config_hash, task_id, thread_id, worktree_id and snapshot_id are captured exactly. Root, profile, profile configuration, task and thread are fixed for every reuse decision.
inputManifest.observations: One observation per selector stores only state, a content hash, file and directory counts, and byte count. A missing explicitly selected path is an explicit negative observation; Git tracking is not required and later creation changes it. Tree hashes include sorted relative paths, file byte hashes and directory membership, so additions and removals invalidate the selector.

required_fields.name: report_path
required_fields.constraint: Non-empty local path, max 4096 bytes; Core reads one regular non-symlink file only.

required_fields.name: inputs_path
required_fields.constraint: Non-empty path to one shin.execution-inputs.v1 manifest, max 4096 bytes.

required_fields.name: receipt_id
required_fields.constraint: Non-empty producer-owned opaque id, max 128 bytes.

required_fields.name: producer
required_fields.constraint: Non-empty producer id, max 128 bytes; trust is not granted by this field.

required_fields.name: started_at
required_fields.constraint: Unix seconds in 0..253402300799; inputs.captured_at <= started_at <= observed_at.

required_fields.name: observed_at
required_fields.constraint: Unix seconds in 0..253402300799 and no later than the importer clock.

required_fields.name: command_fingerprint
required_fields.constraint: Lowercase fnv1a64:<16 hex> or sha256:<64 hex>; sanitized descriptor only.

required_fields.name: complete
required_fields.constraint: Must be explicitly true; false or omission rejects the import.

import.junit_dialects: Conservative UTF-8 testcase hierarchy with suite/testcase properties, run/fail/disabled status, separate disabled/skipped counters when both are present, standard failure/error/skipped nodes and bounded flaky/rerun markers. CTest pass/fail/disabled output and Playwright JSON reporter probes are exercised; other dialects can be rejected rather than guessed.
import.complete: The producer must explicitly set complete=true. Well-formed XML or JSON bytes, an import graph, or a source/test file cannot declare completion or completeness.
import.time: captured_at <= started_at <= observed_at <= importer clock. started_at, inputs and report are required on imported receipts but remain optional on generic receipts.
import.counting: Only normalized report counters, format, byte count, content hash and producer metadata are retained. Test names, errors, properties, stdout, stderr, report paths, attachments and screenshots are never retained.

dialect.junit: UTF-8 XML only, with no DOCTYPE or ENTITY. The conservative allowlist is one testsuite or testsuites root, nested testsuite/testcase elements, recognized testcase attributes, and properties/system-out/system-err/failure/error/skipped/flakyFailure/flakyError/rerunFailure/rerunError metadata. Unknown elements, attributes, duplicate attributes or contradictory counters reject. A non-empty summary-only report with non-zero counters rejects; an empty zero summary is allowed and is unknown.
dialect.playwright: UTF-8 JSON with unique keys and the required errors array, stats.expected/unexpected/flaky/skipped, suites/specs/tests, expectedStatus, status, results and contiguous retry values. Declared stats must match the observed suite cases; malformed or contradictory data rejects.
dialect.browser: This imports counters only. It is not semantic browser validation and does not treat screenshots as correctness proof.

import.file_policy: Read one explicitly named regular non-symlink local report. Input request, manifest and bundle stay outside the consumer; a report may be in or outside a test-output directory.

applicability.profile: All fixed binding fields, worktree_id and snapshot_id must match. No file-scoped or remote equivalence is inferred.
applicability.declared-complete: If every explicitly captured selector still matches, worktree_id or snapshot_id drift outside those inputs does not invalidate the receipt. A selector change, including an explicitly selected missing-to-present change or tree addition/removal, invalidates it. This is accepted only from an explicit producer declaration and explicit file/tree selectors; Git tracking is not required.
applicability.partial: Partial input coverage never narrows invalidation; use conservative whole-profile applicability.
applicability.currentness: For profile coverage, inputs_current checks the entire current binding. For partial selectors, inputs_current checks only selected inputs and does not alone imply scope_current; fixed binding and whole-profile worktree/snapshot applicability still decide scope_current. declared-complete may narrow only the worktree_id/snapshot_id differences outside its explicit selectors.
applicability.unknown: Untrusted, future, expired, mismatched, failed, skipped and unknown receipts remain explicit. A receipt never turns a source or test record into executed evidence by itself.
applicability.fallback: Profile selection and fallback behavior are unchanged. This optional workflow does not infer a profile or merge indexes.

trust.producer: Source isolation, execution environment, command correctness and receipt transport are producer/host responsibilities. A pre/post hash is not continuous execution attestation.
trust.trusted_producer: Only an explicit --trusted-producer host policy can make a producer trusted. A receipt, imported artifact or producer self-declaration cannot grant its own trust. No signing or remote authentication is implemented.
trust.command: command_fingerprint is a sanitized producer descriptor fingerprint. Core preserves it but cannot prove which command ran or whether it is the command desired now.

assessment.clock: Every receipt in one assessment uses a single clock observation after captured-input scans. receipt-check and Resume publish it as observed_at; Impact with receipts publishes receipts_observed_at. TTL classification is as of that observation, not continuous freshness. Explicit --observed-at is an as-of assessment override, never a way to renew expired runtime evidence.
assessment.receipt_check: Strict requires a nonempty receipts array and every assessed receipt to have passed_current=true. --require-current is a separate Knowledge Base freshness requirement and does not mean the receipts passed. receipt-scope and receipt-import also accept optional --require-current.
assessment.failed_receipts: Receipt failures and next_actions are reported separately; failure remains failure and is never converted to static completeness.
assessment.impact: Impact strict remains static inspection completeness. Receipt evidence is an additional separate array and never changes tests_to_review, source verification levels or static inspection completeness.
assessment.resume: Resume and receipt-check use the same receipt assessment. Checkpoints may carry the same bounded optional inputs and report metadata; no second compatibility path is created.

nonGoals: screenshots as automatic UI correctness proof

verification.boundary: Run the listed checks against the public source candidate; historical internal receipts do not qualify it.
required: real local report and performance probes
